readerNotes.line: Traced the heavy ticked line from the top edge north of Geilenkirchen, around the Roer and Monschau, around the Bulge (Stavelot, north face to Hotton and Rochefort, down the west side to St Hubert, around the Bastogne corridor) then east along the Sure and south down the Moselle and Saar to the east edge near 6.85, 49.22. The west face south of Rochefort is drawn as a doubled wavy line, read as front. A thin line running south from the east exit to Faulquemont is read as a boundary, not the front.
